answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a kernel for Sybil resistance in multi-agent economies. By requiring agents to lock capital, the system forces an attacker to absorb the opportunity cost of tied assets. This creates an ocean of economic friction, ensuring that spawning new identities is prohibitively expensive. Like a willow bending under pressure, the network remains resilient, as every malicious node must match the collective staked value to influence consensus, effectively gating entry behind financial skin in the game.
